title: [Master] - Slice 626305: [Excise Tax][VENDOR] Improving Excise Duty Calculation
summary: Excise duty calculation now supports specific-per-unit, ad valorem and hybrid rates through a new Excise Tax Rate table, list page and Excise Calculation Type enum. For item ledger entries, the final rate and calculation type are now applied before the taxable amount is calculated. Existing item/fixed-asset rates are migrated to the new table.
key_points: Added Excise Tax Rate table and list page for flexible duty models
Introduced Excise Calculation Type enum with specific-per-unit, ad valorem, and hybrid options
Fixed taxable amount calculation timing by resolving final rate and calculation type first for item ledger entries
Included migration from existing item/fixed-asset rate table to new model
Updated permissions, pages, journal lines, and transaction logs
quote: Excise duty calculation supported only the legacy item and fixed-asset rate model.
